messages:
Jordan: I opened PR #2578 to refresh the Quickstart Hello app: unify JS/Py snippets to the new SDK, standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY, and shorten the Dockerfile. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2578. Can @Priya or @Ethan glance?
Priya: Skimming. Agree SDK-first. Keep a one-line curl as a quick smoke check but mark it as advanced. Also the Python snippet still imports `OldClient` 1 should be `RedwoodClient`.
Ethan: I'll update the py snippet and add a safe accessor for outputs (e.g., `text = resp.output[0].text if resp.output else resp.text`). Also remove the `--platform` flag from Dockerfile to avoid confusing ARM users.
Jordan: Good catches. I'll change all `REDWOOD_KEY` to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and add a tiny migration table mapping older env var names.
ci-bot: /docs/lint 1 issue: missing language tag on one code fence.
Jordan: fixing now, adding '```python' and '```javascript' where appropriate and shortening the sample prompt to "Write a friendly greeting" to keep outputs small for smoke tests. Pushed commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/aa11ff3
Priya: small wording nit: replace "5-minute setup" with "Quickstart: get running in minutes". Also add troubleshooting callout: "401? confirm REDWOOD_API_KEY is set and not expired."
Ethan: added an npm script `smoke` and a tiny smoke.js that does a one-off generate for CI. Works locally with a dev key.
ci-bot: /docs/lint 1 all checks passed for PR 2578.
Jordan: thanks all 1 will merge after final CI and then cherry-pick the migration blurb into /guides/migration. :sparkles:
